title: Trouble on Titan
author: Jim Flynn
description: UAC keeps sending you to Titan to investigate strange occurrences. You reported aliens after the Mines, the Anomaly site, and Farside. Psychology still prefers space psychosis. You only get a pistol — just in case there aren't any aliens after all.

reviews.text: Opening section is a mentally fatiguing puzzle slog. Ugly, but very complex, with lots of height variation and switch puzzles.
some errors found in jdoom, and not enough weapon
A large, complex and very good map.
